AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Provides a university student's own data at Inha University in Tashkent (IUT), read from what the IUT app has cached on the phone: the class timetable, open coursework on eClass, class attendance against the absence limits the student set, and grades. Operational Patterns: - 'getNextClass' answers where and when the next class is; 'getSchedule' lists one day. - 'getUpcomingDeadlines' lists open work only; submitted assignments, attempted quizzes and fully watched lecture videos are left out. - 'getAttendance' with a course name answers about one course; without one it lists every course, those near their absence limit first. Constraints: - Read-only. The functions never go online, sign in or change anything; each result says when its data was last fetched. - Times are the phone's local time (Asia/Tashkent, UTC+5). - Absence limits come only from the student; when none is set the result says so and no limit is assumed. - When data is missing the error says what the user can do in the IUT app.
